components.name: Complete lower-band actual-root collision classification and minimal repair
components.project_addition: Strengthen P017 L055 by observing that its r>=5 exclusion and s>=8 exclusion do not use k>=9. This reduces every possible lower-band root collision to the exact finite cases 5<=k<=11 and proves that the entire collision set is exactly (k,p,r,s)=(5,2,3,3),(6,2,3,4),(8,2,3,5). Using the P023 finite repair-multiplicity theorem, derive the exact minimum root-shell repair alphabet: two symbols only at k=5,6,8 and one otherwise for k>=4. The uniform bit 1[q>floor(k(k+2)/3)] is proved to equal the p=2 shell indicator on all actual lower-band states and repairs every collision.
